New mail, reply, forward, and drafts open in a separate window, so the mailbox stays usable. Closing that window does not send. On a resumed draft, type an optional Window label near the heading to identify that open editor in the Window menu. The title uses a generic name until you type a label, and the label clears when you reopen the draft. Compose starts at up to 1200 × 900, fitted inside the opening window’s display work area. The Message editor grows with the window and scrolls long quotes internally; Send, Save draft and Close stay visible while compact layouts scroll the draft controls. A stacked original preview is height-limited, with Collapse and Hide still available. The saved side-by-side divider width is retained. Editing and attachment help is a collapsed disclosure; attachment preparation and errors remain visible. A− and A+ adjust font size one step at a time. Text color opens swatches for common colors, Default text color, and Custom…. Formatting applies to the selection or text you type next. Command+Z on Mac or Ctrl+Z on Windows undoes edits in the focused field, including formatted paste in Message. Fresh Reply and Reply All subjects add Re:; Forward adds Fwd:. Existing English prefixes are retained; consecutive matching reply/forward prefixes, recognized Chinese/Japanese forms, AW:/WG: and numeric counters are normalized without losing Unicode subject text or mixed reply/forward history. Manually edited subjects, resumed drafts and recovered scheduled mail retain their saved subject through preview and send. Send with an undo delay closes it and waits in Outbox. Reply and Reply All prefer Reply-To addresses when supplied, exclude your own addresses, and avoid duplicate recipients. Replies to locally sent mail, including historical bot mail from aliases, remain available while the Sent copy is waiting to sync. Finish or cancel AI writing before Save, Send or Schedule. In compose fields, the native right-click menu offers available spelling corrections plus Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste and Select all. Selecting a correction updates the draft through normal editor input without AI. Suggestions depend on the operating system and installed dictionaries; this is spelling, not grammar checking. No words are automatically added to a dictionary. Suggested replies appear inside Write with AI. Selecting one preserves the signature and fills an empty prompt without generating or sending. The prompt supports multiple lines and vertical resizing; Enter adds a new line and Ctrl/Command+Enter generates. Suggestions wait while writing is active. AI data permission remains required. Confirmation uses the reviewed message; changes require a new preview. To, Cc, and Bcc suggest up to eight addresses already in synced mail on this computer, ranked by how recent and how often they appear. Suggestions match the address at the cursor. Use the arrow keys and Enter, or click a suggestion, to complete that address and keep the other recipients as typed. Tab closes the list and moves focus. You can also type addresses manually. Enter without a highlighted suggestion still previews the send. Suggestions do not read a contacts directory or add a provider scope. Recipients, subject, body and Close remain available while From identities load; Save, Send and Schedule wait for identity validation. Late defaults and signatures do not replace newer typing. Concurrent alias checks share one request; a failed automatic check waits 30 seconds before another attempt. Address history is built in a worker and updated only for changed headers, not unrelated flag or body writes. Preview Send and scheduled previews show safe HTML from the reviewed snapshot, with external images blocked even when received-mail images are enabled. Included attachment names and sizes stay visible.
